zh: 结果发现，问题只是一根线松了。
en: It {turns} out the problem was just a loose cable.

zh: 我以为咖啡馆关门了，结果原来是我把地址搞错了。
en: I thought the cafe was closed, but it {turned out} that I had the wrong address.

zh: 我们没赶上末班车，最后只好走路回家。
en: We missed the last bus and {ended|wound} up walking home.

zh: 我本来只是进去买牛奶，结果最后花了五十块。
en: I only went in for milk, but I {ended up|wound up} spending fifty dollars.

zh: 再等下去没有意义了，他不会来了。
en: There's no {point|use|sense} in waiting any longer; he's not coming.

zh: 抱怨天气没有任何意义。我们又改变不了。
en: There's {no point|no use} complaining about the weather. We can't change it.

zh: 每次看那个视频，我都忍不住笑。
en: I can't {help} laughing every time I watch that video.

zh: 我总是忍不住觉得我们忘了什么东西。
en: I can't {help} thinking we've forgotten something.

zh: 如果你有一个下午的空闲，那个博物馆绝对值得一去。
en: That museum is definitely {worth} visiting if you have a free afternoon.

zh: 值得问一下银行能不能降低手续费。
en: It's {worth} asking the bank whether they can lower the fee.

zh: 我还不习惯靠左开车。
en: I'm not {used|accustomed} to driving on the left yet.

zh: 在惠灵顿过了两个冬天，我已经习惯了这里的大风。
en: After two winters in Wellington, I've got {used to|accustomed to} the wind.

zh: 我上大学的时候，以前每个周末都打篮球。
en: I {used} to play basketball every weekend when I was at uni.

zh: 这个街角以前有一家面包店，但去年关门了。
en: There {used to} be a bakery on this corner, but it closed last year.

zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里做饭，也不想出去吃。
en: I'd {rather|sooner} stay home and cook than eat out tonight.

zh: 你更愿意上午开会，还是午饭后开？
en: Would you {rather} have the meeting in the morning or after lunch?

zh: 时间不早了。我们最好出发了。
en: It's getting late. We'd {better} get going.

zh: 你最好别把自行车整晚放在外面，可能会被偷。
en: You'd {better} not leave your bike outside overnight; it might get stolen.

zh: 我三点钟应该到牙医那儿，所以得早点走。
en: I'm {supposed|meant|due} to be at the dentist at three, so I need to leave early.

zh: 按规定你不应该把车停在这里。这是住户专用的。
en: You're not {supposed|allowed|meant} to park here. It's for residents only.

zh: 我刚刚正要给你打电话！真巧。
en: I was just {about|going} to call you! What a coincidence.

zh: 快点，电影马上就要开始了。
en: Hurry up, the film is {about to|going to} start.

zh: “我什么时候把发票发过去？”“越快越好。”
en: "When should I send the invoice?" "The sooner the {better}."

zh: 我们得订机票了，而且越早越好，因为票价一直在涨。
en: We need to book the flights, and the {sooner} the better, because prices keep going up.

zh: 这取决于天气。如果天气好，我们就在外面吃。
en: It {depends} on the weather. If it's fine, we'll eat outside.

zh: 要花多少钱取决于来多少人。
en: How much it costs depends {on} how many people come.

zh: 据我所知，那家店周四营业到晚上九点。
en: As {far} as I know, the shop is open until nine on Thursdays.

zh: 据我所知，从周五到现在没有人动过服务器。
en: {As far as I know}, nobody has touched the server since Friday.

zh: 万一烧烤那天下雨怎么办？
en: {What} if it rains on the day of the barbecue?

zh: 要不我们三个人平摊账单，怎么样？
en: What {if} we split the bill three ways instead?

zh: 你怎么不吃呢？你不饿吗？
en: How {come} you're not eating? Aren't you hungry?

zh: 发票上的金额怎么会比报价高呢？
en: {How come} the invoice is higher than the quote?

zh: 下一班火车还要等一个小时，所以我们不妨去喝杯咖啡。
en: The next train isn't for an hour, so we {might|may} as well grab a coffee.

zh: 反正商店都关门了，我们不如回家吧。
en: The shops are all closed anyway, so we might as {well} go home.

zh: 你今天喝了四杯咖啡？难怪你睡不着。
en: You've had four coffees today? No {wonder} you can't sleep.

zh: 难怪这台电脑这么慢，它开了五十个标签页。
en: {No wonder} the laptop is so slow; it's got fifty tabs open.

zh: 我非常期待下周见到你。
en: I'm really looking {forward} to seeing you next week.

zh: 我今晚不想做饭。我们叫外卖吧？
en: I don't {feel} like cooking tonight. Shall we get takeaways?

zh: 我们可以坐公交，也可以开车。你来决定。
en: We can go by bus or by car. It's {up} to you.

zh: 我等不及要去试试那家新开的饺子店了。
en: I can't {wait} to try that new dumpling place.

zh: 走到火车站大约需要二十分钟。
en: It {takes} about twenty minutes to walk to the station.

zh: 要是我有更多时间练习英语就好了。
en: I {wish} I had more time to practise my English.

zh: 该走了，出租车在外面等着呢。
en: It's {time} to go; the taxi is waiting outside.

zh: 不管我重启多少次，这个应用还是一直闪退。
en: No {matter} how many times I restart it, the app keeps crashing.

zh: 我连房租都快付不起了，更别说出国度假了。
en: I can barely afford the rent, let {alone} a holiday overseas.

zh: 我口语练得越多，就越有自信。
en: The more I practise speaking, the {more} confident I feel.

zh: 我登录银行账户时遇到了困难，一直登不上去。
en: I'm having {trouble|difficulty|problems|issues} logging in to my bank account.

zh: 我们现在在奥克兰买不起房子。
en: We can't {afford} to buy a house in Auckland right now.

zh: 路上这么堵，我们肯定会迟到。
en: With this much traffic, we're {bound|sure|certain|going} to be late.

zh: 你走的时候一定要把门锁好。
en: {Make} sure you lock the door when you leave.
